title: CleanYourTV: remove the ads from your Android TV over Wi-Fi

facts.description: Debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get a clean home screen (GitHub description)
facts.method: pm disable-user on preloaded apps; nothing uninstalled; restore script undoes each step (README)
facts.requirements: Android TV or Google TV; developer options and USB debugging on the TV; a computer on the same Wi-Fi (README)
facts.limits: Fire TV gets the debloat half only; Samsung (Tizen), LG (webOS), Roku and Vizio are not supported (README)
facts.media_plan: README banner and docs images; the Halloween promo is excluded from the script; before/after screenshots to be taken from SHOWCASE.md (repo's own media)

verify_before_render: Check SHOWCASE.md for the repo's own before/after screenshots. No filming.
Do not use the Halloween promo or its dates in any copy.
Capture pack repo-cleanyourtv-01 must be built before render.

scenes.heading: ADS OFF YOUR ANDROID TV, NO ROOT
scenes.say: Is your Android TV home screen full of ads?

scenes.heading: CleanYourTV
scenes.sub: a clean home screen for Android TV
scenes.say: CleanYourTV removes the preinstalled apps and gives you a clean home screen, over Wi-Fi. You don't need root, and nothing gets uninstalled.

scenes.heading: THREE STEPS
scenes.say: On the TV, turn on developer options and USB debugging. Then, on a computer on the same Wi-Fi, run the three steps from the guide.

scenes.heading: NOTHING UNINSTALLED
scenes.say: Preloaded apps are only disabled. One restore command brings back the stock home screen.

scenes.heading: WHAT WORKS WHERE
scenes.say: It works on Android TV and Google TV. Fire TV gets only the cleanup part. Samsung, LG and Roku aren't supported.
Which TV brand would you clean first? Comment CLEAN and I'll pin the link.
